# Commands

`<x>` = required, `[x]` = optional. `ign` = Minecraft username (defaults to the sender for in-game commands).

## Slash commands

Permissions: **Everyone**; **Staff** = members with `STAFF_ROLE_ID` (owner-only when unset) plus the owner; **Owner** = `OWNER_ID`.
† = takes an optional `account` option when more than one Minecraft account is configured (default: the account owning the channel, else account 1).

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/alliance blacklist add <player> <category> [reason] [public]` | Staff | Add a player to your guild's alliance blacklist |
| `/alliance blacklist remove <player>` | Staff | Remove a player from your guild's alliance blacklist |
| `/alliance blacklist check <player>` | Staff | Check a player against the alliance blacklist |
| `/alliance blacklist list` | Staff | Show the whole alliance's blacklist |
| `/alliance blacklist sync` | Staff | Push local blacklist entries that are missing on GuildLB |
| `/alliance blacklist autosync <enabled>` | Owner | Also send /blacklist add and remove to GuildLB |
| `/blacklist add <username> <reason> [discord]` | Staff | Add a user to the blacklist |
| `/blacklist list` | Staff | List the users in the blacklist |
| `/blacklist remove <username>` | Staff | Remove a user from the blacklist |
| `/credits` | Everyone | Shows credits for this bot. |
| `/demote <username>` † | Staff | Demotes the given user by one guild rank |
| `/execute <command>` † | Owner | Executes the given command as the minecraft bot |
| `/force-unverify <user>` | Staff | Remove another Discord user's link. (Staff only) |
| `/force-verify <user> <username>` | Staff | Link another Discord user to a Minecraft account. (Staff only) |
| `/gexp` † | Everyone | Shows the guild's weekly GEXP leaderboard |
| `/guildtop` † | Everyone | Shows the top 10 weekly guild EXP earners. |
| `/help` | Everyone | Shows help for the bot! |
| `/inactive` † | Staff | Lists members below the weekly GEXP requirement |
| `/information` | Everyone | Shows information about this bot. |
| `/invite <username>` † | Staff | Invites the given user to the guild |
| `/kick <username> [reason]` † | Staff | Kicks the given user from the guild for the given reason |
| `/link <username>` | Everyone | Link your Hypixel account to this bot. |
| `/linked` | Everyone | Check who you're linked as |
| `/members` † | Everyone | List the guild members the bot is tracking. |
| `/mute <username> <time>` † | Staff | Mutes the given user for the given time period |
| `/online` † | Everyone | Number of online members. |
| `/ping` | Everyone | Shows the bot's Discord gateway ping. |
| `/promote <username>` † | Staff | Promotes the given user by one guild rank |
| `/reqs` † | Staff | Lists guild members who don't meet the join requirements |
| `/setrank <username> <rank>` † | Staff | Sets the given users guild rank to the given value |
| `/setup panel` | Owner | Open the settings panel. |
| `/setup show` | Owner | Show every setting. |
| `/setup export` | Owner | Download every setting as a JSON file (no secrets). |
| `/setup import <file>` | Owner | Load settings from a /setup export file. |
| `/unmute <username>` † | Staff | Unmutes the given user |
| `/unverify` | Everyone | Unlink your Discord account from your Minecraft account. |
| `/uptime` | Everyone | Shows how long the bot process has been running. |
| `/verify <username>` | Everyone | Link your Discord account to a Minecraft account. |
| `/waitlist` | Everyone | Check your position on the guild waitlist |
| `/whitelist add <username> <reason> [discord]` | Staff | Add a user to the whitelist |
| `/whitelist list` | Staff | List the users in the whitelist |
| `/whitelist remove <username>` | Staff | Remove a user from the whitelist |

## In-game commands

Anyone in guild or officer chat can run these. The default prefix is `!`. Each command can be switched off in `/setup` → Commands (the "Toggle" key).
Replies go out through the account that saw the command, and pass the ban-safety filter (docs/safety-filter.md).

| Command | Aliases | Toggle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `!8ball <question>` | — | `8ball` | Answers a question like a magic 8-ball. |
| `!accessories [ign]` | `!acc` | `accessories` | Counts a player's accessories and lists their IDs. |
| `!bestiary [ign]` | — | `bestiary` | Shows a player's Bestiary kills and mob families. |
| `!boo [ign]` | — | `boo` | Scares a player. |
| `!boop [ign]` | — | `boop` | Boops a player. |
| `!calculate <expression>` | `!calc` | `calculate` | Evaluates arithmetic with + - * / % and parentheses. |
| `!catacombs [ign]` | `!cata` | `catacombs` | Shows a player's Catacombs level and floor completions. |
| `!chocolatefactory [ign]` | `!cf` | `chocolatefactory` | Shows a player's Chocolate Factory progress. |
| `!coinflip` | — | `coinflip` | Flips a coin. |
| `!crimsonisle [ign]` | `!ci` | `crimsonisle` | Shows a player's Crimson Isle faction reputation. |
| `!dojo [ign]` | — | `dojo` | Shows a player's Dojo points per exercise. |
| `!essence [ign]` | — | `essence` | Shows a player's essence of every type. |
| `!fairysouls [ign]` | `!fs` | `fairysouls` | Shows how many fairy souls a player has found. |
| `!floor <floor> [ign]` | — | `floor` | Shows completions, best score and best time for one Catacombs floor (e.g. 7 or m7). |
| `!forge [ign]` | — | `forge` | Shows a player's active Forge items. |
| `!garden [ign]` | — | `garden` | Shows a player's Garden level, plots and crop milestones. |
| `!guild <guild name>` | — | `guild` | Shows a guild's info. |
| `!guildexp [ign]` | `!gexp` | `guildexp` | Shows a player's weekly guild experience. |
| `!guildof <ign>` | — | `guildof` | Shows which guild a player is in. |
| `!hotm [ign]` | — | `hotm` | Shows a player's Heart of the Mountain level. |
| `!jacob [ign]` | — | `jacob` | Shows a player's Jacob's Farming Contest medals. |
| `!kuudra [ign]` | — | `kuudra` | Shows a player's Kuudra completions per tier. |
| `!mayor` | — | `mayor` | Shows the current SkyBlock mayor and their perks. |
| `!meow` | — | `meow` | Meows back. |
| `!networth [ign]` | `!nw` | `networth` | Shows a player's SkyBlock networth. |
| `!player <ign>` | — | `player` | Shows a player's Hypixel rank, network level and first login. |
| `!powder [ign]` | — | `powder` | Shows a player's mithril, gemstone and glacite powder. |
| `!rtca [ign]` | — | `rtca` | Shows the Master Mode 7 runs a player needs to reach class average 50. |
| `!skills [ign]` | — | `skills` | Shows a player's skill levels. |
| `!skyblock [ign]` | `!sb` | `skyblock` | Shows a player's SkyBlock level, purse plus bank, and skill average. |
| `!slayer [ign]` | — | `slayer` | Shows a player's slayer XP per boss. |
| `!specialmayor` | — | `specialmayor` | Estimates when the next special mayor takes office. |
| `!trophyfish [ign]` | `!tf` | `trophyfish` | Shows a player's Trophy Fish totals and best tiers. |
